title: GPU benchmark harness in the repo + a playbook so any agent can measure a RunPod card
description: MPI-1054 measured five cards with a one-off script in a session scratchpad. Fabio wants it kept and documented: move it to scripts/bench-gpu-klein.mjs (keys from env, nothing machine-specific in the public repo), write docs/playbooks/gpu-benchmark/README.md (method, calibration rule, traps that cost money, how a result lands in GPU_GEN_SECS), route it from docs/README.md. Next cards to check: A100 PCIe, L40, RTX PRO 4500 SE.
